subject.title: fix(cloud-workers): reconcile workspace results across turns

question: After reviewing an exact-head repeated-turn cloud-worker proof, should the cloud-worker owner accept this remote accepted-state publication transaction for merge?
rationale: The patch changes durable reconciliation ordering and remote workspace mutation; only a real worker run can establish that the intended transaction and recovery behavior hold outside mocks and focused tests.

options.title: Require exact-head live proof
options.body: Request a redacted repeated-turn worker run that proves publication, verification, conflict handling, and recovery before approving the PR.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the transaction tests and changed checks while accepting that real worker publication and recovery were not observed on this head.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head live proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted repeated-turn worker run that proves publication, verification, conflict handling, and recovery before approving the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the immediately preceding merged cloud-worker recovery and reconciliation phases and are best placed to evaluate the resulting end-to-end contract.
